caption: The worked example in one column: counts become add-one probabilities, each class score is the prior times its two term probabilities, and the bigger score wins. Notice the term good, which never occurs with the negative class — add-one gives it (0+1)/(2+3) = 0.2 instead of 0.

spec.title: Worked example: 0.08 vs 0.04
spec.aria: A top-to-bottom flow from the two training documents through word counts and add-one smoothing to two class scores, 0.08 positive and 0.04 negative, ending in a positive prediction.
